name: Deadly Attachment
source:
It's been 4 years since Samantha last saw her stepbrother Daniel. Suddenly he comes back home for her eighteenth birthday with his new girlfriend Jess. Sam can't be any happier - she always adored Dan and missed him terribly. But their reunion is ruined with the news of Jess' death. Police considers it to be a robbery, but Sam sensing something fishy, decides to start her own investigation.

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=24512]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
